text:
zoe: Heads-up — planning to publish py/ts SDKs in the 2hr change window starting 14:00 PT. Canary first for both registries. Main risk: previous signer/integrity mismatches. @ben can you watch deploy-bot and hold if anything looks off?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting canary publish: py 1.4.0-canary -> test.pypi.org, ts 1.4.0-canary -> registry.npmjs.org (staging tag).

ben: Watching now. Will hold on manual intervention if we see checksum/signature errors.

carla: Canary failed for TS: integrity checksum mismatch during post-publish verification.
```
npm ERR! integrity checksum failed for @redwood/inference 1.4.0-canary
Expected: sha512-abc123...
Found: sha512-def456...
```

zoe: Ugh. Likely a packaging step or CI cache. Prefer stepwise: yank TS canary tag, repack, re-run canary. Don’t roll forward main publish yet.

ben: Yanked npm dist-tag for ts canary: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/inference canary` (executed). For PyPI twine deletes are restricted — we can reupload a new canary build with a different build ID. deploy-bot, did you remove the TS tag?

deploy-bot: remove tag step executed at 1736503800. PyPI: artifact uploaded but wheel digest flagged; holding further publish attempts.

emily: I’ll open a quick template PR to strip non-deterministic build metadata (timestamp/embed hashes) and re-run pack. Also adding a short note in the release_notes draft: "TS canary temporarily held due to integrity mismatch; py canary proceeded."

nikhil: Decision for coordination: hold final GA publish until both canaries are green. If packaging fix takes >2 hrs, fallback plan is to pin server-side clients to 1.3.x via feature-flag to avoid auto-upgrade. Command to set pin: `DEPLOY_PIN_SDK=1.3.9-locked && ./infra/apply-flags --env prod`

carla: ACK. Also adding rollback/runbook steps to the release doc: how to yank packages and force clients to the pinned version. Example rollback command for our internal release helper: `scripts/release --rollback 1.4.0 --targets py,ts`

ben: Repacked locally and checksum matches on `npm pack` now. Will publish a new ts-canary (different build id) in ~10m and share logs.

deploy-bot: Canary publish for ts 1.4.0-canary (repacked) succeeded on registry.npmjs.org at 1736505620.

zoe: Great. Emily — update release_notes.md with an explicit bullet about the canary hiccup + mitigation: "fix: packaging checksum; holdback applied to TS canary; GA gated until both canaries pass." Also add quick FAQ on pinned versions for customers.

emily: On it. Also adding a short postpublish checklist item: run smoke matrix (py 3.9/3.10, node 18/20) and verify telemetry for failed tokenization edgecases.

zoe: After main publish we flip the auto-update flag. If smoke fails, revert to 1.3.9-locked and open a postmortem. :thumbsup:
